readiness_steps.title: Orient
readiness_steps.body: Name the source type: grant, tender, quote, panel, expression of interest, market sounding or awarded-contract learning record.

readiness_steps.title: Position
readiness_steps.body: Decide the honest role for this point in time: lead, partner, subcontract, observe, rehearse or build toward a later round.

readiness_steps.title: Qualify
readiness_steps.body: Check eligibility, authority, ABN or vehicle, insurance, licences, policies, experience, cultural permissions, finance and delivery responsibility.

readiness_steps.title: Assemble
readiness_steps.body: Keep evidence warm: examples, referees, photos, source links, budgets, methods, partner roles, asset lists, decision records and delivery proof.

readiness_steps.title: Respond
readiness_steps.body: Answer the exact criteria. Show value, local knowledge, risk control, timing, capacity, governance, partners and evidence without inflating the claim.

readiness_steps.title: Remember
readiness_steps.body: After submission or award, keep the record: what was offered, who won, what was valued, what changed, and what should be ready next time.

capability_statement: The legal or practical vehicle: company, sole-trader setup, co-op pathway, auspice body, partner group or project crew
The role being claimed now: lead, partner, subcontract lane, pilot, rehearsal, evidence build or future target
Goods, services, works or coordination capacity that can be delivered truthfully
Relevant experience, examples, pilots, prototypes, public pages, source trails or awarded-contract learning
Licences, insurance, safety, privacy, cultural review, reporting and compliance settings
Key people, equipment, assets, partners, decision rights and capacity limits
Referees, images, links, files, minutes, permission notes or other proof that can survive scrutiny
response_checks: The source is current, official and understood in its own terms
The local vehicle or partner team can meet every mandatory requirement without wishful wording
The pricing covers labour, materials, admin, risk, reporting, travel, cashflow and review time
The response answers every weighted criterion with evidence, not atmosphere
Cultural authority, permissions, privacy and public/private boundaries are handled with care
The delivery plan is credible for island timing, logistics, weather, staffing, communication and documentation
The final submission is made through the official portal, with version, date and confirmation retained
